dataset_name: NASA ISS ECLSS Operational Atmospheric Telemetry Archive
original_source: NASA Technical Reports Server (NTRS) & Spacecraft Telemetry Archive
organism_or_population: Space Habitat Environmental Control Architecture (ISS USOS Modules)
mission_or_experiment: ISS US Lab (Destiny) & Node 3 (Tranquility) Environmental Monitoring
known_limitations: Pressure telemetry originally recorded in psia requires conversion to kPa (multiply by 6.894757).
Transient scrubber valve cycling spikes must be differentiated from systemic atmospheric degradation.
Sensor measurements reflect centralized manifold telemetry rather than micro-pocketing.
usage_and_access_restrictions: Public domain engineering telemetry. Open access for research.
